_readme: Per-client repos ONLY (ETL + config). Shared frontend/backend are in knowledge/platform-repos.json. For lower envs, clone the branch below then OVERLAY the OCI live config — see profile.md + runbooks/fetch-live-config.md.

etl.note: Upgrade/staging/QA branch = etl_assortment_planning_u (_u = upgrade). No dedicated QA branch — use _u for QA.

config.note: Clone allocation-configs, THEN overlay the env's OCI bucket (fetch-live-config.md). No QA branch — QA config lives only in OCI.
